sn_aia_tool.description: Calculates a priority score (0-100) for each outdated plugin based on security risk, dependency chain depth, version age, and service mapping impact. Higher scores indicate more urgent upgrades.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"outdated_plugins","description":"JSON string of outdated plugin data from the identification step","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: Compute Priority Score
